text: 中国人民银行统计，2026年二季度末，本外币住户贷款余额82.91万亿元，同比下降1.3%，上半年减少3674亿元。其中，经营性贷款余额25.79万亿元，同比增长2.8%，上半年增加6889亿元。不含个人住房贷款的消费性贷款余额20.83万亿元，同比下降1.7%，上半年减少3400亿元。
text_en: The PBOC reported that at the end of Q2 2026, domestic and foreign currency household loans totaled 82.91 trillion yuan, down 1.3% year-on-year, with a decrease of 367.4 billion yuan in H1. Among these, operating loans were 25.79 trillion yuan, up 2.8% year-on-year, with an increase of 688.9 billion yuan in H1. Consumer loans excluding personal housing loans were 20.83 trillion yuan, down 1.7% year-on-year, with a decrease of 340 billion yuan in H1.
